requests.title: Save a link from a form and list it
requests.body:
## Owner request

"Save a link from a form and list it." (request 1 of the sample set in forger's ADR 0012)

## What exists

The server, the page and the storage layer (`src/server.ts`, `src/app.ts`, `src/storage.ts`, `public/`).

## What to build

A form on `/` with an address and an optional title. Saving stores the link and shows it at the top of the list, newest first, without a reload. `POST /api/links` and `GET /api/links`. An address that is not http or https is refused with a message that names the field, and nothing is stored.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Test `a saved link is returned first by GET /api/links` passes
- [ ] Test `an address that is not http or https is refused and nothing is stored` passes
- [ ] Test `a link saved with no title is listed by its address` passes
- [ ] Test `links stored before a restart are still listed` passes
- [ ] UI state "full list": screenshots under `docs/screenshots/` show a saved link at the top of the list
- [ ] Gates green

## UI states

Empty: "No links saved yet". Loading: the save button is disabled while saving. Failed: the message under the field. Full: the list, newest first.

## Guards

`.forger/coverage-baseline.json` holds the line-coverage floor; it is not lowered.

## Placement

`src/`, `public/`

none

when green

- Tests: storage, handler and validation tests
- Fixtures and shared regions: none
- Stored shapes: a links table, created when the database is empty

requests.title: Tag a link and filter the list by tag

## Owner request

"Tag a link; filter the list by tag." (request 2 of the sample set in forger's ADR 0012)

## What exists

Saved links and the list from the save request.

## What to build

requests.title: Reject a link already saved, saying which one
requests.body:
## Owner request

"Reject a link already saved, saying which one." (request 3 of the sample set in forger's ADR 0012)

## What exists

Saving, listing and tags from the earlier requests. Nothing stops the same address being saved twice.

## What to build

Saving an address that is already stored is refused. Two addresses are the same when they differ only in the case of the scheme or host, a trailing slash, or a fragment. The refusal names the stored link by its title and when it was saved, and nothing new is stored. `POST /api/links` answers 409 with the stored link.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Test `saving the same address twice is refused with status 409 and the stored link` passes
- [ ] Test `addresses that differ only in host case, a trailing slash or a fragment count as the same` passes
- [ ] Test `addresses that differ in their path or query are both saved` passes
- [ ] Test `a refused duplicate stores nothing` passes
- [ ] UI state "duplicate refused": screenshots under `docs/screenshots/` show the message naming the stored link
- [ ] Gates green

## UI states

Failed: "Already saved: <title>, on <date>" under the address field. The other states are unchanged.

requests.title: Share the list by a link that is read-only for visitors
requests.body:
## Owner request

"Share a list by a link that is read-only for visitors." (request 5 of the sample set in forger's ADR 0012)

## What exists

One list of saved links, with tags and search. There is no way to show it to someone else.

## What to build

A control that makes a share address for the list: a path with a long random token. The page at that address shows the links, their tags and the search, and has no form and no control that changes anything. Every request that changes data under a share address is refused. Making a new share address stops the old one working.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Test `a share token gives the list through GET` passes
- [ ] Test `a POST under a share address is refused and stores nothing` passes
- [ ] Test `an unknown share token answers 404` passes
- [ ] Test `making a new share address stops the old one` passes
- [ ] UI state "shared view": screenshots under `docs/screenshots/` show the shared page with the list and no form
- [ ] Gates green

## UI states

Shared view, empty: "Nothing saved here yet". Shared view, full: the list with no form. The owner's page gains the share control and shows the address.

requests.title: Import links from an exported bookmarks file
requests.body:
## Owner request

"Import links from an exported bookmarks file." (request 6 of the sample set in forger's ADR 0012)

## What exists

Saving with the duplicate rule, tags and the list.

## What to build

A control that takes a bookmarks file in the HTML format browsers export. Each bookmark becomes a link with its title; the folder names it sits under become its tags. A bookmark already saved is skipped by the duplicate rule, and one whose address is not http or https is skipped. The result says how many were added and how many skipped, with the reason for each kind. A file that is not a bookmarks file is refused and nothing is stored.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Test `a bookmarks file with nested folders imports each link with its folder names as tags` passes
- [ ] Test `a bookmark already saved is skipped and counted` passes
- [ ] Test `a bookmark whose address is not http or https is skipped and counted` passes
- [ ] Test `a file that is not a bookmarks file is refused and nothing is stored` passes
- [ ] UI state "import result": screenshots under `docs/screenshots/` show the counts of links added and skipped
- [ ] Gates green

## UI states

Loading: the import control is disabled while the file is read. Failed: "This is not a bookmarks file". Done: "<n> added, <n> skipped" with the reasons.

requests.title: A saved link with an unusual address breaks the list
requests.body:
## Owner request

"A bug: a saved link with an unusual address breaks the list." (request 7 of the sample set in forger's ADR 0012)

## What exists

The list renders each stored address and title. Addresses arrive from the form and from the import.

## What to build

Reproduce it first: a failing test that saves links whose address or title holds a quote, an angle bracket, an ampersand, non-ASCII letters and a very long path, then reads the list. Then fix what the test shows. If nothing fails, keep the test and say so in the PR.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Test `a link whose address holds a quote, an angle bracket and an ampersand is listed with its address intact` passes
- [ ] Test `a link whose title holds markup is shown as text` passes
- [ ] Test `a link with non-ASCII letters in its address opens the same address` passes
- [ ] Test `an address longer than the list is wide does not push the list out of its column` passes

requests.title: Spike: how should the product send a weekly digest
requests.body:
## Owner request

"A spike: how should the product send a weekly digest." (request 8 of the sample set in forger's ADR 0012)

## What exists

Nothing sends anything. The product has stored links with the time each was saved.

## What to build

A written answer under `docs/`, in the spike template: what the digest holds, who it goes to, how it is sent and scheduled, what it costs to run, and what must exist first. It ends with the build tickets it would need, each with criteria in a checkable form. No product code changes.

## Acceptance

- [ ] `ls docs/spikes/weekly-digest.md` exits 0
- [ ] `grep -c "## Thresholds" docs/spikes/weekly-digest.md` prints 1
